title: The Words — Sc063: Darwin leans on Carrie — her smile falls last (109 frames)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: A two-character scene built as a single nested placement: the scene timeline has one 'animation' layer with one puppet instance, and both performances - Darwin's (445 kf puppet, 1,226 kf in the largest head comp) and Carrie's ('car head' 189 kf plus her mouth/eye comps) - are choreographed inside it, including their position swap mid-shot. The scene also repeats the episode's signature reaction device: Carrie keeps her pleasant face for the entire exchange and drops it only in the last frame, after Darwin has exited - the audience gets her true reaction as a private final beat.
notes: Both characters live inside ONE scene-level placement: the 'animation' layer holds a single GB200_DRW_ORIGINAL_PUPPET_v001 instance (445 kf, internal end frame 170 vs the scene's 109), and Carrie's performance ('car head' 189 kf, GB200_CARRIE_MOUTHCOMP_V002, Carrie eye comps) is nested inside it - there is no separate Carrie layer.

Beat from the sheet: Carrie opens alone, calm (f1); Darwin pops in and leans on her, grinning (f15), performs big (f28), startled (f41); they trade laughs (f55-69); Darwin exits left in slices (f82-95); Carrie, alone again at f109, finally drops her smile into a worried open-mouth reaction.
Same delayed-reaction device as Sc059 (Masami): the listener's face changes only in the final frame, after the performer has left the shot.
